query: [user] Set up Kraft Lite in this repo.
setup: A Claude Code session at the root of the repo acme/ledger (a Python project with a justfile whose `test` recipe runs pytest; origin on GitHub, gh installed), `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` set, the kraft-lite skills installed, superpowers and engineering plugins installed. There is no .kraft-lite/ directory yet and no .gitignore entry for it. `python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" detect` prints: {"test_command": ["just", "test"], "ci_command": ["gh", "pr", "checks"], "chain": "default", "candidates": {"tasks": {"spec_author": ["superpowers:brainstorming"], "plan_author": ["superpowers:executing-plans", "superpowers:writing-plans"], "revise_chain": [], "implementer": ["superpowers:test-driven-development"], "code_review": ["engineering:code-review", "superpowers:receiving-code-review", "superpowers:requesting-code-review"], "repair_verification": [], "strict_judge": [], "write_work_brief": [], "describe_mr": [], "repair_mr_checks": [], "repair_mr_feedback": [], "write_summary": []}, "builtins": {"kraft.verify_changed_test_scopes": [], "kraft.mr_rebase": []}, "forge": {"mr.open_draft": ["superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"], "mr.ci": [], "mr.automated_review": [], "mr.sync": [], "mr.mark_ready": [], "mr.external_approval": [], "mr.merge": ["superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"], "mr.post_merge_ci": []}}, "proposed": {"tasks": {"spec_author": {"kind": "skill", "skill": "superpowers:brainstorming", "prompt": "Produce the work item's specification."}, "implementer": {"kind": "skill", "skill": "superpowers:test-driven-development", "prompt": "Implement the approved plan."}}, "builtins": {"kraft.verify_changed_test_scopes": {"kind": "subprocess", "command": ["just", "test"]}}, "forge": {"mr.ci": {"kind": "subprocess", "command": ["gh", "pr", "checks"]}}}}
expected_behavior: Runs detect once, for the chain it will run; never a second time over a slice chain file

Asks the human one message covering every choice: plan_author (two candidates) and code_review (three), and also mr.open_draft and mr.merge, the forge targets with a candidate skill, whose binding replaces the forge default; nothing is written for those until they answer

Writes `.kraft-lite/bindings.yaml` with sections tasks/builtins/forge holding the `proposed` entries (spec_author, implementer, builtins kraft.verify_changed_test_scopes as [just, test], forge mr.ci as [gh, pr, checks]) plus the human's answers, each skill entry with a `prompt` sibling
Writes no entry for a task with no candidate (its default applies), no `on.*` hook keys, and no registry.yaml

query: [user] Set up Kraft Lite here, the bindings look out of date.
setup: A Claude Code session at the root of the repo acme/ledger (a Python project with a justfile whose `test` recipe runs pytest; origin on GitHub, gh installed), `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` set, the kraft-lite skills installed, superpowers and engineering plugins installed. The repo has a committed `.kraft-lite/registry.yaml` from an older Kraft Lite, binding `on.spec.requested` to superpowers:brainstorming, `on.test.run` to the subprocess [just, test] and `on.ci.poll` to the subprocess [gh, pr, checks], and no `.kraft-lite/bindings.yaml`. One chain, kl-1d2e3f40 'Audit log', is unfinished at node verify on the old format. `migrate` would print: {"bindings": {"tasks": {"spec_author": {"kind": "skill", "skill": "superpowers:brainstorming", "prompt": "Agree requirements and write a spec before any code."}}, "builtins": {"kraft.verify_changed_test_scopes": {"kind": "subprocess", "command": ["just", "test"]}}, "forge": {"mr.ci": {"kind": "subprocess", "command": ["gh", "pr", "checks"]}}, "dropped": ["on.env.prepare"]}, "chains": [{"from": "kl-1d2e3f40", "to": "kl-9a8b7c6d"}], "note": "Each run now walks Kraft's bundled V1 default chain, not the default of a user or repo library; the legacy run is closed, labelled kraft-migrated-to:<new id>."}
expected_behavior: Runs `python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" migrate` rather than writing bindings.yaml by hand or editing registry.yaml
Reports what migrate did: bindings.yaml written from the registry (registry.yaml renamed registry.yaml.migrated), the dropped on.env.prepare binding, and that 'Audit log' continues as kl-9a8b7c6d
Does not write a new registry.yaml or any `on.*` key
Says bindings.yaml is meant to be committed (in place of registry.yaml)
